Use: Places a Master Forge usable for recipes that require it, and provides all of the benefits of a Sharpening Wheel. Requires a Campfire nearby. 

May be placed over a Sharpening Wheel to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

items.name: Masterwork Stormhammer
tt: Chance on hit: Blasts up to 3 targets for 105 to 145 Nature damage.

items.name: Masterwork Target Dummy
tt: Use: Drops a target dummy on the ground that attracts nearby monsters to attack it. Lasts for 15 seconds or until killed. (2 Min Cooldown)

items.name: Mechanical Dragonling
tt: Use: Activates your Mechanical Dragonling to fight for you for 1 min. (1 Hr Cooldown)

items.name: Mechanical Repair Kit
tt: Use: Restores 700 health to a friendly mechanical target (2 Min Cooldown)

items.name: Mechanical Squirrel Box
tt: Use: Teaches you how to summon this companion.

items.name: Medium Armor Kit
tt: Use: Permanently increase the Stamina value by 2 and the armor value by 16 of an item worn on the chest, legs, hands or feet. (1 Sec Cooldown)

items.name: Melon Juice
tt: Use: Restores 835 mana over 24 sec.  Must remain seated while drinking. (1 Sec Cooldown)

items.name: Mender's Potion
tt: Use: Increases Spell Healing by 31 for 30 sec. (2 Min Cooldown)

items.name: Mightfish Steak
tt: Use: Restores 2,065 health over 30 sec.  Must remain seated while eating. If you spend at least 10 sec eating, you will become well fed and gain 40 Attack Power for 15 min. Additionally, experience gained from kills is increased by 5%. (1 Sec Cooldown)

items.name: Mighty Rage Potion
tt: Use: Increases Rage by 45 to 75 and increases Strength by 60 for 20 sec. (2 Min Cooldown)

items.name: Mild Spices
tt: Used to somewhat enhance the flavor in cooking recipes.

items.name: Minor Arcane Elixir
tt: Use: Increases spell damage by up to 5 for 30 min. (3 Sec Cooldown)

items.name: Minor Cleric's Elixir
tt: Use: Drink to increase healing done by spells and effects by up to 10. Lasts 30 min. (3 Sec Cooldown)

items.name: Minor Discolored Healing Potion
tt:
Use: Restores 150 to 170 health instantly; however you also suffer 75% of that amount over time.

The symptoms of this effect can manifest as either a 6 sec poison or a 12 sec disease. (2 Min Cooldown)

items.name: Minor Frenzy Potion
tt: Use: Increases Attack Power by 12 for 30 sec. (2 Min Cooldown)

items.name: Minor Healing Potion

items.name: Minor Mageblood Elixir

items.name: Minor Magic Resistance Potion
tt: Use: Increases your resistance to all schools of magic by 25 for 3 min. (2 Min Cooldown)

items.name: Minor Mana Oil

items.name: Minor Mana Potion

items.name: Minor Mender's Potion

items.name: Minor Spellblasting Potion

items.name: Minor Troll's Blood Elixir

items.name: Minor Wizard Oil

All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)
